adjudication.rationale: The new `removeMember` action in `admin-group.js.es6` calls `self.get("model").removeMember(member);` inside the `bootbox.confirm` callback without attaching any `.then/.catch` (and the action doesn’t return that promise). In `discourse/models/group.js`, `removeMember` only reloads members in a success `.then(...)` and has no error handling; on 422/404/500 the rejection is not surfaced to the UI and the list is not refreshed, so the member remains displayed with no feedback. This behavior is introduced by this diff along with the new DELETE endpoint usage.
